ownership: VPP remains the sole voxel generator/presenter and owns native LOD, meshes/material composition, moving collision invokers and lifecycle. UE owns origin scheduling, world/render/physics translation and transform publication. Adapter callbacks translate retained domain/presentation caches. No new VPP/engine patch, streaming manager, copied mesh renderer or material slot override is added.
fixes: Use world-scoped UE post-origin callbacks to translate cached native mesh transforms while retaining strict lifecycle/identity checks.
Translate retained current/previous charts, camera/visual history and hit positions; preserve local/scalar/directional/physics meanings.
Republish retained native VPP component transforms through UE MarkRenderTransformDirty after verified origin translation; fixes the measured reverse-shift frustum failure with culling enabled.
nativeFeaturesReused: UWorld::RequestNewWorldOrigin, applied by native world tick through SetNewWorldOrigin
VPP retained original UVoxelNaniteComponent, runtime/state/LOD/material/collision and attached moving invoker
Native deferred USceneCaptureComponent2D and real GPU readback using existing anchored shader/CPU oracle

cooked.cookReuse: Unchanged assets/shaders reused through the package script's fingerprint-guarded --skip-cook path. All 229 protected inputs retain their initial hashes; no material/shader asset regeneration occurred.

exclusions: Fixed coverage is a harness input, not a production moving-window/streaming requirement.

No instanced-stamp shift, body rotation/multiple body or multiple-view demand qualification.
